name: wild_honeycomb
description: Wild bees' nest: four pale gold (#e9c25a) wax combs hanging vertically side by side (outer two darker, behind), hex cells with pale capped cells near the top and amber honey cells, a honey drip, three small honeybees on the comb. Anchor centre. Footprint x -94..94, y -112..118. Sits in hollow_tree's hollow.
